keyFindings.description: On the background path (Dispatch) the keeper starts before the first-connection reconcile (ensureStreamOnce) succeeds and gates passes only on Connected(). A keeper pass can read the stream before the reconcile's update and write after it, putting back a subject the reconcile replaced; ensured is then true and the keeper never removes subjects, so it stays wrong until another owner starts. The deep agent reproduced it 23 of 30 times with a 1 ms period (overlay test). Before the reconcile, every pass also logs a false WARN 'could not restore the stream: stream not found'. Fix: no keeper pass until the reconcile succeeded (start it from ensureStreamOnce, or skip while not ensured), still awaited when Close comes first; add a test.

startDispatchStream says it connects as main does but omits serverClient, so every Dispatch stream test runs the synchronous path while main.go:206 runs the background one. The quality agent's overlay mutation (background path reconciles with plain streamCfg, no keeper) passed all of internal/bus and cmd/dispatch. That leaves the spec's acceptance line (a stream update from the Dispatch server keeps three copies, the byte limit and the id) untested on the path Dispatch runs. settings_test.go:916 asserts a connect error Dispatch no longer returns. Fix: build it with serverClient, wait for the reconcile, and assert copies, limit, id and the keeper there; assert the refusal through the logged error.
